html:
Uganda was one of the first countries hit by HIV, which appeared around Lake Victoria in the early 1980s, where people called the wasting disease slim.

By the early 1990s a large share of adults in towns was infected, and the Rakai district on the Tanzanian border was badly hit. Unlike many leaders, Museveni spoke openly about the epidemic from 1986, and the government, churches and groups such as TASO ran frank campaigns on abstinence, faithfulness and condoms.

Infection rates fell sharply during the 1990s, one of the earliest declines anywhere, and Uganda became a model in the global AIDS fight. It shared the lake shore with later hard-hit parts of southern Africa.
sum: Uganda was one of the first countries hit by HIV, which appeared around Lake Victoria in the early 1980s, where people called the wasting disease slim.
